name: Cascade-Correlation
summary: A constructive supervised-learning pattern that adds hidden units trained to correlate with residual error, then freezes their incoming weights.

name: Perceptron
summary: A fixed-capacity linear classifier that updates its bias and input weights after misclassified examples.

name: Grow When Required
summary: An unsupervised topology-growth method that combines match activity and node habituation to choose between adaptation and insertion.

name: Dynamic Node Construction
summary: A constructive backpropagation method that adds a hidden node when normalized average-error improvement falls below a trigger slope.
